# Mana Hospitals, Gajularamaram, Hyderabad

> Mana Hospitals (మన హాస్పిటల్స్), a unit of Wecare Lifeline Healthcare Pvt. Ltd., is a multispeciality hospital
> in Gajularamaram, Hyderabad, Telangana 500072 with 18 specialist consultants, a 24×7 emergency department,
> ICU and NICU, in-house diagnostics, dialysis and pharmacy, and cashless insurance support.

## Key facts
- Address: Plot No. 219, beside SBI Bank, Mahadevapuram Colony, Gajularamaram, Hyderabad, Telangana 500072, India
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?cid=3478330352746109876 (17.5166458, 78.4144235)
- Hospital phone / appointments: +91 79958 95858 (WhatsApp available)
- Emergency (24×7): +91 99669 94859
- Email: info@wecaremana.com
- Hours: Emergency, ICU and NICU open 24 hours, 7 days. OPD Mon–Fri 9 AM–9 PM, Sat 9 AM–6 PM, Sun 10 AM–2 PM.
- Insurance: cashless and reimbursement with major insurers and TPAs.
- Areas served: Gajularamaram, Mahadevapuram Colony, Jeedimetla, Quthbullapur, Shapur Nagar, Chintal, Suraram, Jagathgiri Gutta, Kukatpally, Nizampet, Bachupally, Pragathi Nagar, Kompally, Dundigal, Bowrampet, Gandimaisamma.

## Specialities
- [General Medicine & Diabetology](https://wecaremana.com/general-medicine.html): Diabetes, hypertension, thyroid, fever and infections — with same-day consultation, an on-site laboratory and 24×7 emergency backup behind every appointment.
- [Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement](https://wecaremana.com/orthopaedics.html): Fractures and trauma, arthritis of the knee, hip and shoulder, ligament and sports injuries — with arthroscopy, joint replacement and physiotherapy on site.
- [Nephrology & Dialysis](https://wecaremana.com/nephrology.html): Complete kidney care — from early detection and medical management through to haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, with ICU and 24×7 emergency behind it.
- [Gastroenterology & Surgical Gastro](https://wecaremana.com/gastroenterology.html): Acidity and GERD, IBS, IBD, pancreatitis, jaundice and liver disease — with diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy alongside advanced laparoscopic surgery.
- [Neurology & Neurosurgery](https://wecaremana.com/neurology.html): Stroke, seizures, headache, neuropathy and movement disorders — with CT and MRI, on-site EEG and EMG–NCV, and 24×7 emergency cover.
- [Pulmonology & Chest Medicine](https://wecaremana.com/pulmonology.html): Asthma, COPD, allergy, pneumonia, tuberculosis, interstitial lung disease and sleep apnoea — with spirometry, bronchoscopy and sleep studies.
- [Obstetrics & Gynaecology](https://wecaremana.com/gynaecology.html): Comprehensive maternity care and women's health, from preconception to postnatal — with paediatric and anaesthesia support alongside.
- [Urology & Stone Care](https://wecaremana.com/urology.html): Kidney stones, prostate problems, urinary infections, andrology and incontinence — with laser stone treatment and minimally invasive prostate surgery.
- [Piles, Fissure & Fistula (Proctology)](https://wecaremana.com/piles-fissure-fistula.html): Bleeding, pain or a lump while passing stools? Our anorectal surgeons treat piles, fissures, fistulas and pilonidal sinus — with laser and minimally invasive options and quick recovery.
- [General & Laparoscopic Surgery](https://wecaremana.com/general-surgery.html): Hernia, gallbladder stones, appendicitis, lumps and cysts — treated with keyhole (laparoscopic) surgery wherever possible, for smaller scars and a faster return home.
- [Paediatrics & Child Care](https://wecaremana.com/paediatrics.html): Fevers, coughs, vaccinations, growth and nutrition — care for newborns, children and teenagers, with NICU support and 24×7 emergency in the same building.
- [24×7 Emergency & Critical Care](https://wecaremana.com/emergency-critical-care.html): Accidents, chest pain, breathlessness, stroke, poisoning or high fever — our emergency department, ICU and NICU are staffed around the clock, every day of the year.
- [ENT — Ear, Nose & Throat](https://wecaremana.com/ent.html): Ear pain, hearing problems, sinusitis, tonsils, snoring and voice problems — diagnosed and treated, including ENT surgery, by an ENT surgeon for adults and children.
- [Radiology & Diagnostics](https://wecaremana.com/radiology-diagnostics.html): CT, MRI, ultrasound, X-ray, Doppler and laboratory tests in the same building as your doctor — reported by a radiologist, with most results the same day.
- [Infertility & Fertility Care](https://wecaremana.com/infertility.html): Trying to conceive without success? Step-by-step evaluation and treatment for couples, led by a gynaecologist with a fellowship in reproductive medicine.
- [Diabetes & Thyroid Care (Diabetology)](https://wecaremana.com/diabetes-care.html): Sugar control, insulin, thyroid and cholesterol — personalised plans from diabetologists, with same-day lab tests and regular follow-up.
